annotations.title: Search the Danish West Indies papers

description: Search the Danish West Indies newspapers, 1770–1885, page by page, as the Royal Danish Library (Mediestream) holds them: Sanct Thomæ Tidende, the Danish-era St. Croix Avis, the St. Thomas Herald and the Saint Croix Bulletin. OPENED, NOT PRESERVED: the library keeps these papers; this archive made them searchable and links every page to the library's copy. A separate collection from this server's other papers, read only by this tool. words="danish" (the default) searches your words as typed, with Danish letters folded (æ→ae, ø→o, å→a), because the library's OCR has none, and on pages before 1816 also the long-s spelling (an s printed like an f and read as f). words="english" turns your English words into the Danish forms the papers printed, from a word list made by machine and not yet checked by a reader of Danish; every answer names each Danish form searched, and the English word is searched too, since some papers and notices are English. Nothing is translated. The OCR is poor (by the library's own estimates about half the characters on a typical page are misread), so search finds what scanned well and misses a great deal; we are working to improve it. Each result is one page: paper, date, page, the library's estimate of its OCR quality, a short snippet labeled uncorrected OCR (not fit to quote), and the library's page link to read and check. Hit counts are pages, never articles. An empty result is not evidence that the papers never printed it.

date_from.description: Earliest date: a year (1848) or a day (1848-07-03), within 1770–1885.

date_to.description: Latest date, same forms; a year includes all of it.

long_s.description: Default true: also search the long-s spelling on pages before 1816. false turns it off.

page.description: Results page, 20 pages of the papers per results page. Default 1.

paper.description: "Sanct Thomæ Tidende", "St. Croix Avis", "St. Thomas Herald", "Saint Croix Bulletin", or a slug. Leave out for all four.

query.description: Names, places, ships, streets or words. Quote a phrase to require it intact. Danish letters may be typed or not.

words.description: "danish" (default): search the words as typed. "english": search English words through the Danish word list.
